about: Signals launch, from the swiss-grid template: a visitor lands on a pricing page and the camera snaps onto her cursor; Breakout listens to 35+ signals and lists them under her name, one at a time; then Breakout's website agent (recreated from the owner's screenshot, assets/refs/agent-widget.png) and the AI SDR email use them, the camera zooming onto each personalization token. Headlines verbatim from the Signals launch email (Sachin, 2026-11); signal names verbatim from getbreakout.ai/signals; findings, chat and email illustrative and approved by the owner. Times in bars at 128 BPM (1 bar = 1.875 s).
